components.name: ICS-VEX Reverse SBOM Builder
components.description: Reverse-builds a CycloneDX SBOM-CVE per ICS device from the CISA ICS-CERT advisory corpus.

component.name: Siemens SIMATIC
component.description: ICS/OT asset 'SIMATIC' by Siemens, reverse-built from CISA ICS-CERT advisory data.

components.name: dnsmasq
components.description: DNS cache and DHCP address-assignment service within the cell network.

components.name: Linux Kernel
components.description: Device operating-system kernel. Provides scheduling, memory management, and the device-driver layer.
